scenarios.name: Hide and restore Team Web from Show Panels

scenario_steps.name: the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Team Web panel is visible
the user opens Show Panels from the Options panel title menu
the Team Web panel disappears from the Tools ribbon
the other visible Tools panels remain available
the user reopens Show Panels from the Options panel title menu
the Team Web panel appears on the Tools ribbon
Show Panels marks Team Web as visible
